title: SPA/16/2015 of Km Pratibha Tiwari AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
SPA No. 16/2015
Hon'ble K.M. Joseph, C.J.
Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.

Mr. BS Adhikari, Advocate for the
appellant.
 Mr. Pradeep Joshi, Standing Counsel for
the State/respondent nos. 1 to 4.
 Let notice be issued to respondent no.5 by
registered AD, returnable at an early date.
 In addition to normal mode of service, the
appellant is permitted to take out notice DASTI
for service of the same on respondent no.5.
